name: zerodelta
description: ZeroDelta: a 3-agent swarm that plans, confidentially solves, and risk-guards delta-neutral cross-chain rebalances using NEAR Intents (NEP-413) and NEAR Chain Signatures.

scripts.contract:build: cd contracts/risk-guard && cargo +1.81.0 build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zerodelta_risk_guard.wasm res/
scripts.contract:build:v3: cd contracts/risk-guard-v3 && cargo +1.81.0 build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p res && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zerodelta_risk_guard_v3.wasm res/
